evidence.curator_note: Ortho-effect hydrogen rearrangement (rH): the alkoxy O+. abstracts the ortho Y-H through a six-membered transition state, transferring H to oxygen and leaving the radical on Y. Book draws 2 arc(s); moves 1,2 are drawn (one electron of the Y-H bond to Y giving the radical site, and the other Y-H electron carrying the migrating H toward the alkoxy O+.), move 3 is an implicit homolysis hook (the O+. odd electron pairing into the new O-H bond) required for electron balance (not drawn on the page). The migrating hydrogen (map 1) is written as [1H] - ordinary protium with its isotope pinned, NOT deuterium - solely so RDKit's default parser retains it as a mapped atom (a plain mapped [H] is stripped by removeHs), letting the O-H and new O-H bond changes be bookkept.

Inductive loss of HOR (labelled 'i' beside the -HOR arrow): the protonated ester C-O(alkyl) bond breaks heterolytically and the acylium C#O+ forms. Book draws 1 arc(s); move 1 is drawn (full double-barbed arrow moving the C-O(ester) bond pair onto the protonated alkoxy oxygen, expelling neutral HOR), move 2 is an implicit arc (carbonyl-oxygen lone pair forming the third bond of the C#O+ acylium) required for electron balance (not drawn on the page).

Cross-linked MOD rules for eq 4.41: IMS_4_41_rH (H migration to the unsaturated hetero-structure with cleavage of the neighbouring X-H bond) encodes step_rH; its DFS cleaves [_A]-[H] and forms [O+]-[H] with the radical moving to _A, matching step_rH with _A instantiated as the ortho phenolic O. IMS_4_41_ind1 encodes step_elimination: its DFS cleaves the ester C-[O+] bond and forms the aryl C#O+ acylium while expelling H-O-R, matching this step exactly. IMS_4_41_ind2 encodes the SAME loss of HOR but written as the resonance/quinoid ketene form (structure 4 on the page: Y=C exocyclic, ring +. , C=C=O); it faithfully describes the drawn resonance partner of the acylium product I chose here (structure 3). All three DFS bond changes were verified by inspection; no mismatch found.

The page scheme is generic (Y, R) and prints no m/z. m/z 120.020 (C7H4O2+.) is computed for the chosen instantiation Y=OH, R=CH3 (methyl salicylate); precursor m/z 152.046 is likewise instantiation-derived. This instantiation corresponds to the real, prominent loss-of-CH3OH fragment (m/z 120) in the EI spectrum of methyl salicylate, but the value here is curator-computed, not read from the book. Resonance note (convention C): the product ion is drawn in two forms on the page; the localized acylium form (structure 3) is encoded, its ketene/quinoid resonance partner (structure 4) is not a separate species.
